title: Organic Maps: free AllTrails Plus alternative
caption:
AllTrails charges $35.99/year to download trail maps for offline use. Organic Maps does it for free 🗺️

✅ Offline maps and search, no signal needed
✅ Hiking trails, cycling routes and walking paths with elevation profiles
✅ Turn-by-turn voice navigation + dark mode
✅ No ads, no tracking, no data collection, 100% free

📱 iPhone · Android
ℹ️ Heads up: it's a general offline map built on OpenStreetMap data, not AllTrails' curated trail reviews and photos, and you download each region before you go

Comment "MAPS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
